lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six observable vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with the highest spatial density concentrated along the horizontal mid-line of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a series of grid-like nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow pixels on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-luminance fusiform silhouette (commensal fish) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin region.
